meta.description: Solar Purchase Finance origination flow on ONDC:FIS12:PF. Discovery uses a 3-round search/on_search pattern (per PRD sections 5.1/5.2): each round resubmits the previously completed inline form (field-based xinput.form.data, no hosted form URL) so the BPP can progressively reveal Merchant & Product Details (F01), then Personal Information (F02), and finally return a personalized, binding solar loan offer. Ordering proceeds through select/on_select, an offline single-redirection verification journey (KYC, eMandate, Bank Account Verification, eSign) surfaced via unsolicited on_status callbacks and a dynamic form wizard, and concludes with LOAN_SANCTIONED confirmation. Disbursal to the merchant is contingent on a later BAP-attested installation confirmation.
